name: google_compute_firewall
description: Each network has its own firewall controlling access to and from the instances

network.name: network
network.description: The name or self_link of the network to attach this firewall to

description.name: description
description.description: An optional description of this resource

priority.name: priority
priority.description: Priority for this rule. This is an integer between 0 and 65535

direction.name: direction
direction.description: Direction of traffic to which this firewall applies

source_ranges.name: source_ranges
source_ranges.description: Source IP CIDR ranges for ingress rules

destination_ranges.name: destination_ranges
destination_ranges.description: Destination IP CIDR ranges for egress rules

source_tags.name: source_tags
source_tags.description: Source network tags for ingress rules

target_tags.name: target_tags
target_tags.description: Target network tags for the rule

source_service_accounts.name: source_service_accounts
source_service_accounts.description: Source service accounts for ingress rules

target_service_accounts.name: target_service_accounts
target_service_accounts.description: Target service accounts for the rule

disabled.name: disabled
disabled.description: Denotes whether the firewall rule is disabled

project.name: project
project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs
